composition_subtypes.role: sort by coordinate to define left-right order
DP over order: res[i] min cost with pin at i, trans to j>i

payload.core_composition_summary: Sort marbles by coordinate, then 1D DP to choose optimal pin set minimizing pin costs plus leftward roll distances.
payload.rationale: Sorting enables linear order; DP computes min cost with state = last pinned marble, transitions account for unpinned rolling left. First must be pinned to avoid infinity.
